name: Zima Bakasko
source:
Zima is the former princess of the walled city that belonged to the Alekino Country in the Free Cities Alliance. Zima is a beautiful young lady with long blonde hair and great skills at archery, boasting an impressive popularity in the kingdom. [spoiler]However, it was this popularity which one day led a witch filled with jealousy of Zima's popularity and beauty to change her into a monster[spoiler].

[Edited from [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Zima_Bakasko]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
